methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.

aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led browsers (tablet) in Netherlands at 61.66% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 28.92%, followed by Samsung Internet at 3.06%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (tablet) in Netherlands?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 61.66% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/tablet/netherlands.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (tablet) in Netherlands?
faqs.answer: Chrome (61.66%), Safari (28.92%), Samsung Internet (3.06%) in October 2026.
